description: EgoHumans camera selections used by HSfM (Muller & Choi et al., 'Reconstructing People, Places, and Cameras', CVPR 2025) for its 2-, 4- and 8-view evaluation settings. The main-paper tables report the 4-view case; Table S.1 additionally reports 2- and 8-view. Source: supplementary section S.4.2.

conventions.camera_indexing: 1-indexed. Paper 'camera N' maps to view id 'camNN' (zero-padded), matching egohumans_sequences.json view ids.
conventions.all_sentinel: "all" means every available view of the sequence (used where the paper says 'all 8 available cameras').
conventions.activity_keys: Keys are the activity prefixes of our sequence names (e.g. 'legoassemble'); the paper labels these 01_tagging..07_tennis.
conventions.training_set: None. HSfM evaluates every sequence of each activity under its activity's per-view-count selection; no sequences are held out for training.

notes: 'all' for tagging/legoassemble/basketball in the 8-view case reflects that those activities provide exactly 8 cameras.

Our preprocessed dataset drops some cameras that these selections reference (our preprocess merges near-static cameras via --merge-translation-tolerance / --merge-rotation-tolerance). Against the current snapshot the unreproducible pairs are: 4-view volleyball (all lack cam11) and badminton (12/60); 8-view fencing (only 7/14 have cam15), volleyball (cam11), badminton (cam15), tennis (all lack cam07). 2-view and 4-view tennis/fencing/etc. are fully satisfiable. Re-preprocess without static-camera merging to recover the missing views before running those settings.
